family_findings: All 17 original registration expressions are present in the shipped OnActivate body.
The owner is not wired into shipped CustomRendererManager lifecycle; ARTIST explicitly constructs it, registers it after Prepare, re-registers when already prepared, and destructs it.

Five current manager stand-in bools map onto the exact bytes occupied by the embedded component's override/layer controls in ARTIST. The proposed patch removes duplicate storage and uses the exact DecFIGS accessors.

The current colour path has two same-named class declarations with incompatible members; the separate helper writes cache vectors, not the six registered slider fields. SetBoostColourToCustom and two callback helpers are absent as source bodies. The proposed patch unifies the class and connects existing BoostBarRenderer methods.
The candidate source patch is not compiled or run. Native menu, render, and visual behavior remain unverified.
